name: Polanger – Admin Menu Manager
author: Polanger

sections.description:
Polanger – Admin Menu Manager is a lightweight and powerful admin menu editor that gives you full control over your WordPress admin menu. Whether you want to hide admin menu items, rename them, or change their icons – this plugin makes it simple.

Clean up your WordPress dashboard menu by hiding unnecessary items, give custom names to menu entries, and personalize icons – all from a beautiful, modern interface. Perfect for developers, agencies, and site owners who want a cleaner dashboard menu hide experience.

Why Choose This Admin Menu Editor?

  • Simple & Fast – No bloat, just the features you need
  • Hide Admin Menu Items – Remove clutter from your WordPress sidebar instantly
  • Dashboard Menu Customization – Full control over your admin area
  • Visual Feedback – Color-coded indicators show what’s hidden or modified
  • No Coding Required – Point and click interface

Features

  • Hide Menu Items – Hide any main menu or submenu item from the admin sidebar
  • Rename Menu Items – Give custom names to any menu or submenu item
  • Change Icons – Choose from 200+ Dashicons to customize menu icons
  • Submenu Support – Full control over both main menus and their submenus
  • Visual Indicators – Color-coded rows show hidden, renamed, and modified items at a glance
  • Reset Option – Easily reset all settings to defaults with one click
  • Modern UI – Clean, intuitive interface that fits perfectly with WordPress admin

Pro Features

Take your WordPress admin control to the next level with Polanger Admin Menu Manager Pro.

Menu & Admin Bar:
* Role-based menu visibility – Show/hide menus per user role
* Drag & drop menu reordering – Organize your admin sidebar
* Block direct URL access – Prevent bypassing hidden menus
* Admin bar customizer – Hide or rename admin bar items

Security Features:
* Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) – Email-based verification codes
* Custom login URL – Hide wp-login.php from attackers
* Google reCAPTCHA v2/v3 – Protect login forms
* Brute force protection – Block repeated failed attempts
* Recovery keys – Backup access for 2FA

Activity & Monitoring:
* Activity log – Track all admin actions with timestamps
* Email alerts – Get notified of critical events
* Export logs – CSV and JSON export options
* IP tracking – See who accessed what and when

Login Page Customizer:
* Custom logo and background
* Custom colors and styling
* “Remember Me” default option
* Hide language switcher

Dashboard Widgets:
* Hide or show widgets per role
* Reorder dashboard widgets
* Clean up WordPress dashboard

Additional Features:
* Access control – Restrict plugin settings to specific users
* Read-only mode – Allow viewing without editing
* Super Admin protection – Prevent lockouts
* Priority support – Fast response times

Get Pro Version
sections.installation:
1. Upload the polanger-admin-menu-manager folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Polanger Admin to configure your admin menu
sections.faq:
How do I hide admin menu items?

After activating the plugin, go to Settings > Polanger Admin. You’ll see a list of all admin menu items. Simply check the box next to any item you want to hide from the dashboard menu.

Will hidden menus still be accessible via direct URL?

Yes, hiding a menu item only removes it from the sidebar. Users can still access the page if they know the URL. For access control, consider upgrading to Pro version.

Can I reset all my changes?

Yes! There’s a “Reset All Settings” button at the bottom of the settings page that will restore all menus to their default state.

Does this admin menu editor work with custom post types?

Yes, the plugin works with all menu items including those added by themes and other plugins.

Is this plugin multisite compatible?

Yes, the plugin works on multisite installations. Each site can have its own dashboard menu settings.
